mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS decline for 3+ consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points triggers market concerns about deteriorating labor conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 0.2pp rise), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a contraction in housing demand, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with both RSAFS and HOUST declining >1% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing supply chain disruptions (INDPRO < 100 index), reduced industrial output and rising input costs pressure corporate margins, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeding 2.5% triggers market expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months signals robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with PAYEMS increase for 3+ consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During strong consumer demand periods (RSAFS MoM growth > 0.5%), elevated retail sales drive corporate revenue growth and profit margins, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with RSAFS MoM growth > 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a broad economic slowdown across manufacturing and construction, reducing corporate investment and economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with both INDPRO and HOUST declining >1% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
